perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following information:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn and less vibrant than usual during their shifts at the bank.
- When he asked if she was okay, Patricia said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and Patricia said she appreciated it.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned that managing finances can be stressful and offered to discuss financial planning strategies with her.
- Patricia said that could be helpful and that she had been overwhelmed with her bills lately.
- He suggested looking over budgeting tips together, and Patricia said she would take him up on it soon.
- After that conversation, he worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he told Patricia he only meant to help, not pry.
- Patricia reassured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; Patricia said she appreciated that and was glad she had someone to turn to.
- Later, when he checked in with her, Patricia said she was doing all good and planning a quiet weekend at home; she didn’t bring up her personal or financial issues further.
- He continued to check in with her at work, offering help or even just coffee, and Patricia said she was handling things and appreciated his support.
